title: A MettleUp receipt that fails to load says "Receipt not found"
what: When the owner opens a receipt for a payment to MettleUp and the internet is off or the server does not answer, the page says "Receipt not found. Open it again from Settings, Pay MettleUp, Your receipts." There is no "Try again" and nothing says the problem is the connection. An owner who needs the receipt for their accounts is told a paid receipt does not exist.
expected: A failed load says the receipt could not be loaded and offers to try again; "Receipt not found" shows only when the server says there is no such receipt for this gym.
how_often: every time a receipt is opened with no internet or while the server is failing
fix_line: Show a could-not-load message with a Try again button, apart from the not-found words
